text: The project is titled 'Let Risen God Jesus be glorified' and is focused on creating a resume database for IT recruiters in the USA and Canada.
The resume database includes IT candidates in the USA currently looking for jobs on various visas, including H1, OPT, EAD, GC, and USC.
The project was launched on Kickstarter and had a funding goal of $847.
The funding period for the project was from March 7, 2015, to March 19, 2015.
The project funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by the deadline.
The resume database is presented in neatly laid out Excel sheets that allow sorting by skill set.
The project claims to be much cheaper than major job portals.
There were no identified risks and challenges associated with the project.
